info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Realestate Listings Favorites-v3-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Favorites API enables users to access and manage their favorite real estate listings. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a curated list of properties they have marked as favorites, enhancing their search experience. Typical consumers of this API include real estate platforms and applications that require personalized property recommendations. By utilizing this endpoint, users can easily track and revisit their favorite listings, making informed decisions in their property search.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of their favorite listings. The data returned includes all the listings that the user has marked as favorites, providing an easy way to access preferred options.

requestBody.description: This endpoint retrieves the user's favorite listings. The request body should contain necessary parameters to identify which listings to retrieve, formatted in JSON.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of favorite listings.
